symptom: GRANT EXECUTE ON NANOFLOW Module.NF TO Module.Role is stored, but permissions() only returns microflow EXECUTE rows; a lint rule over exposed flows misses every exposed nanoflow.
cause: buildPermissions had per-document builders for entities, microflows, pages and OData services and none for nanoflows, although microflows.Nanoflow carries AllowedModuleRoles exactly like a microflow.
insight: The catalog-vs-rule vocabulary test (lint_rule_doc_vocabulary_test) only checks documented ⊆ emitted, so an element type the catalog never emits is invisible to it; add the constant to PermissionElementTypes and the skill row by hand. When verifying with a real lint run, delete <project>/.mxcli/catalog.db between the fixed and unfixed binaries: lint reuses the cached catalog, and the unfixed binary then reports the fixed rows.
